Description: packages/yolo-ui re-exports Dioxus 0.8 RSX, Signals, Router, Fullstack and the 7 YoloThemePreset tokens from crates/yolo-shared
Do: Import dioxus and yolo-ui tokens from the workspace crate
Don't: Pin an older dioxus 0.5/0.6 version from crates.io

Guideline: Use Copy Signals and use_memo for reactivity
Description: Dioxus 0.8 Signal<T> is Copy and tracks reads automatically across RSX and memos without manual RefCell borrowing
Do: Create component state with use_signal and derived state with use_memo
Don't: Wrap signals in Rc<RefCell<T>> or clone state structs on every render
Code Good: let mut count = use_signal(|| 0); let doubled = use_memo(move || count() * 2);

Guideline: Use modern Dioxus 0.8 rsx! attribute interpolation
Description: Dioxus 0.8 rsx! merges adjacent string literals and format expressions directly in class and style attributes
Do: Write clean rsx! elements with semantic classes and YoloThemeTokens CSS variables
Don't: Concatenate HTML strings manually or use inner_html for structured UI
Code Good: rsx! { div { class: "flex gap-4 p-4", style: "background: var(--yolo-bg-surface)", "Hello" } }

Description: dx serve --hot-reload --subsecond patches both RSX templates and Rust closures/functions in-place without losing signal state
Do: Run dx serve with subsecond hotpatching enabled during UI iteration
Don't: Restart the full Cargo build loop for every layout or callback tweak
Code Bad: cargo run (recompiling from scratch on every UI edit)

Guideline: Choose Blitz WebGPU or WebView per target
Description: Blitz renders Dioxus DOM/CSS directly via AnyRender (Vello/WGPU) and Taffy 0.15 without a browser engine
Do: Use dioxus-native / Blitz for lightweight GPU-rendered desktop views and dioxus-web/fullstack for SSR web apps
Don't: Mix incompatible DOM assumptions in native Blitz surfaces
Code Bad: web_sys::window().unwrap() // inside a Blitz native build

Description: Dioxus Fullstack serializes #[server] functions across SSR and WASM hydration and integrates with use_server_future
Do: Await server data via use_server_future inside a SuspenseBoundary component
Don't: Block the main WASM thread or issue raw uncached fetch calls inside render

Guideline: Use dioxus-primitives for accessible headless widgets
Description: submodules/dioxus-components provides ARIA-compliant Dialog, Tabs, Select, Switch, Slider, Popover and Tooltip primitives
Do: Compose UI from dioxus_primitives with YoloThemePreset CSS variables
Don't: Build custom modal or dropdown focus traps from raw div onclick handlers

Description: yolo_ui::shell::AppShell injects the active YoloThemePreset CSS variables (--yolo-bg-primary, --yolo-accent-primary, --md-sys-color-*)
Do: Wrap top-level routes in AppShell with the selected YoloThemePreset
Don't: Hardcode hex colors in inline RSX styles

Guideline: Embed static assets with asset!() macro
Description: manganis asset!() fingerprints, optimizes (WebP/AVIF, CSS minification) and bundles static assets at compile time
Do: Reference images, fonts and stylesheets with asset!("/assets/app.css")
Don't: Hardcode relative filesystem paths that break in bundled desktop/WASM builds

Guideline: Compile React/Shadcn TSX to Dioxus 0.8 via yolo-migrate
Description: crates/yolo-migrator lowers React/Shadcn/Radix/Base UI TSX + Tailwind v4 into idiomatic Dioxus 0.8 #[component] rsx!
Do: Run bun ui migrate <Component.tsx> --target dioxus to port TSX components cleanly
Don't: Manually rewrite large Shadcn TSX trees line by line without token mapping
Code Good: bun ui migrate Card.tsx --target dioxus --preset neutral
Code Bad: // manual copy-paste of JSX tags into rsx!
